content: Buying Kia EV6 was a big mistake. It doesn't charge the 12v battery at all. I took it to the nearest Kia service centre and they charged me £70.00 just to check the battery and the problem is still there. its just 3YO car and they give a 7 year warranty which in my case was not applied as this was a battery issue. thank you for advising me to connect to customer services. just for your info. i already did and they only got me the appointment at the sefvice station after 3 weeks of calling.
